summary: Verified Navbar mobile logo/Register-button overlap fix in Navbar.tsx via Playwright bounding-box measurements at 320/360/375/390px on Home, Events, Contact pages, plus desktop 1920px regression check. Fix confirmed working correctly across all tested scenarios.
critical_code_review_comments: Navbar.tsx fix is clean and minimal (min-w-0/flex-1/truncate on brand, flex-shrink-0 on right controls, whitespace-nowrap on register button, gap-2 safety net) - no code quality concerns.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Navbar mobile overlap bug is now fully fixed and verified at 320/360/375/390px on Home, Events, and Contact pages. Consistent 8px gap between brand and register button at all widths, zero overlap, no horizontal page overflow. Brand text 'SHISFEST'26' fully visible (not truncated) at 375/390px; truncates gracefully to 'SHISFE...' only at 320px as intended safety fallback. Register Now button text fully visible/clickable at all widths, href correct (https://forms.gle/byc7abfP7BYjVKiL6) with target=_blank. Hamburger menu toggle works correctly (opens/closes mobile nav with Home/Events/Contact links, no overlap with register button). Desktop 1920px shows no regression: desktop nav links visible inline, hamburger hidden, normal sized logo/text/button. No further action needed on this bug. Countdown/schedule/map/icon features from prior iterations were not re-tested per scope but no visual regression observed on Home page screenshots.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: on narrow viewports the brand Link element did not shrink (no min-w-0/flex-1), causing it to overflow into the fixed-width Register Now button area, causing visual overlap. Fix applied: made brand a flex-1/min-w-0 shrinkable flex item with truncate on text, reduced logo/text sizing on mobile, made right-side control group flex-shrink-0 so it never gets squeezed, and added whitespace-nowrap + reduced padding/font on Register button, plus outer gap-2 as safety net. Verified via getBoundingClientRect the brand's right edge never exceeds register button's left edge across all tested widths (positive 8px gap consistently).
